en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a large, ornate hall filled with rows of empty chairs. The hall features high ceilings, large windows, decorative wall paintings, and coats of arms. The text at the top of the image identifies the location as 'Institut St-François-Xavier, Bruges' and describes the view as 'Salle des fêtes, vue du fond' (Festival Hall, view from the back). The overall style suggests a formal institutional or educational setting.
